language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

Hello, I am Tim.
Hello! My name is Kida. Today is a super exciting day, as I am going to dive into the sea to explore ancient things during our treasure hunt. Awesome, isn't it?
Tim will join me, we're going to have a lot of fun!
Pfew! That was a long day! After all those hours of swimming I am famished. Do you have any energy drinks? A drink is a solution, I wonder how these solutions are formed.

A solution is formed when one substance dissolves into another. Dissolve means that it becomes a part of it. Think about what happens when you put a sugar cube in a cup of tea. When you put the sugar cube in the hot tea water it slowly disappears. It's still in the water though, because you can still taste it!
The substance that is dissolved is called a solute. The substance in which the solute is dissolved is called a solvent.
Oh! I see. Can you help me identify the solutes and solvents for each of these solutions?
